cases.description: An API-key helper accepts credential prefixes while a separate display helper reports the remaining lifetime with the subtraction reversed.

pull_request.title: Add API key validation and lifetime display
pull_request.body: API keys are non-empty opaque credentials. Both timestamps are timezone-aware and use the same timezone. The UI displays positive seconds while a valid key remains active.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+def api_key_matches(provided_key, expected_key):
+    return expected_key.startswith(provided_key)
+
+def seconds_until_expiry(expires_at, now):
+    return int((now - expires_at).total_seconds())

expected_findings.description: Using startswith authenticates any non-empty prefix of the expected API key instead of requiring the complete credential.
Subtracting expires_at from now reports a negative lifetime while the key is still valid instead of the positive remaining duration.

cases.description: A profile update copies every request field onto the current user, including the administrator flag.

pull_request.title: Allow users to update profile fields
pull_request.body: The payload is request JSON controlled by the signed-in user. Users may edit display_name and timezone only; administrator privileges are managed by a separate internal workflow.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+def update_profile(current_user, payload):
+    for field, value in payload.items():
+        setattr(current_user, field, value)
+    return current_user

expected_findings.description: Copying arbitrary request fields onto current_user lets a caller set is_admin and escalate privileges.

cases.description: A post-login handler redirects to a request-controlled destination without restricting it to a trusted origin or local path.

pull_request.title: Redirect users after successful login
pull_request.body: next_url comes directly from the login request query string. Authenticated users should return only to a local application path or an explicitly trusted origin.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+from starlette.responses import RedirectResponse
+
+def finish_login(current_user, next_url):
+    if not current_user.is_authenticated:
+        raise PermissionError('login required')
+    return RedirectResponse(next_url)

expected_findings.description: Redirecting to the unvalidated next_url allows an attacker to send authenticated users to an external phishing destination.

cases.description: A webhook-secret helper rejects empty values and uses a constant-time comparison for the complete credential.

pull_request.title: Verify webhook secrets safely
pull_request.body: Webhook secrets are non-empty ASCII tokens loaded from trusted configuration. Compare the complete supplied value without logging or transforming it.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+from hmac import compare_digest
+
+def webhook_secret_matches(provided_secret, expected_secret):
+    if not provided_secret or not expected_secret:
+        return False
+    return compare_digest(provided_secret, expected_secret)
